name: wp-repo
description: WordPress monorepo — first-party plugins and themes for Indonesian businesses (companies & UMKM).

scripts.check: turbo run typecheck lint phpstan test:unit build check:bundle-size check:i18n
scripts.clean: turbo run build --force --dry-run=json >/dev/null 2>&1; rm -rf node_modules .turbo plugins/*/node_modules plugins/*/build
